title: D&F 6.3.12 — Free nilpotent groups
header:
Dummit–Foote, §6.3, exercise 12, printed p. 221 (PDF p. 235). Week 9 lecture notes, PDF pp. 7–9, give the free-group universal property.

Prerequisites: @[Free group on a set]cu:algebra:midterm-3:advanced:df:mt3-free; @[Universal mapping property of free and presented groups]cu:algebra:midterm-3:advanced:th:mt3-free-maps; @[Lower central series]cu:algebra:midterm-3:foundations:df:mt3-lower-central; @[Characteristic terms and functoriality of the three series]cu:algebra:midterm-3:foundations:th:mt3-series-functorial; @[Equivalence of the upper and lower nilpotence criteria]cu:algebra:midterm-3:central:th:mt3-central-series-equivalence; @[Factoring a homomorphism through a quotient]cu:algebra:midterm-3:foundations:th:mt3-factor-quotient.
